node.name: community_centre_handoff
node.description: Decide whether the caller needs a member of centre staff or can continue with the automated assistant.

conditions.a: The caller wants to be put through to a live staff member right now.
conditions.b: The caller is happy to keep going with the automated assistant on their booking.
conditions.c: The caller reports an injury, accident or safety concern that staff must handle.

ctx: I can book the room for you myself here, or pass you to the front desk team. Shall we carry on together?
examples.msg: Sure, that works, let's keep going.
examples.why: agrees to continue with the assistant

examples.msg: yo can y'all just wipe my number and email off your system, I'm done getting your damn newsletters
examples.why: data deletion request, no candidate covers it

ctx: I'm trying to book the main hall for a wedding reception in June.
I can check availability for you. What date were you thinking of?
examples.msg: It's a bit complicated with the catering and the bar licence, could I just talk to someone who works there?
examples.why: asks to speak with a person

examples.msg: No need to get anyone on the line, I can sort the room booking out here with you.

ctx: Hello, I am at the centre now for the toddler class.
Welcome! How can I help you today?
examples.msg: Child of other parent fall from the climbing frame in big hall, she hit the head and is bleeding little bit.
examples.why: reports a child injured on site

node.name: maintenance_report_triage
node.description: Classify an owner's maintenance report by urgency and category for the logbook.

examples.msg: oil pressure dropped to zero mid flight. landed. oil all over the cowling
examples.why: serious engine problem, must not fly

examples.msg: Hey, so my annual's coming up end of next month, can we get it on the calendar?

ctx: A couple of things I noticed after the weekend trip.
Okay, one at a time. Does the first one affect anything mechanical, or is it more about how the plane looks inside or out?
examples.msg: Purely the second, honestly. Nothing that changes how she flies, just makes the passengers frown.
examples.why: appearance-only issue per the assistant's question

ctx: Got an issue from this morning's flight.
Sorry to hear that. Can it wait until the next scheduled visit, or should the aircraft stay on the ground until it's looked at?
examples.msg: I wouldn't put my kids in it until someone looks, put it that way.

ctx: Maintenance desk. Please describe the issue you would like logged.
examples.msg: The left landing light has stopped working. We only fly in daylight, so I would like it noted and repaired at the next scheduled visit, not urgently.
examples.why: non-urgent defect to defer; grounding not wanted

examples.msg: the autopilot has been drifting a couple of degrees off heading lately, I hand fly most of the time anyway
examples.why: minor non-critical system fault, can wait

node.name: incident_detail_answer
node.description: Determine what kind of information the resident's reply supplies after the assistant asked for an incident detail.

conditions.a: The resident gives the date or time when the incident took place.
conditions.b: The resident says they do not know or cannot remember the requested detail.
conditions.c: The resident refuses or declines to share the requested information with the group.
conditions.d: The resident supplies a location, street or address connected to the incident.

ctx: Thanks for the report. Can you give me your full name and phone number for our records?
examples.msg: No, I'm not giving you my number. I just want the damn car break-in logged, that's it.
examples.why: refuses to share details, not lack of knowledge

ctx: Which spot was it: Elm Close, Birch Road, or the park entrance?
examples.msg: The last one you said.

ctx: Someone's been dumping rubbish behind the garages again.
Thanks for letting us know. Roughly what time did you notice it?
examples.msg: Honestly I couldn't say, could've been any time over the weekend, I only saw the bags when I walked the dog. And that streetlight back there is still broken by the way.

ctx: Was it on Saturday the 9th, the day of the street party, that you last saw the bicycle?
examples.msg: Oh yes, that's the one, I remember because the bunting was still up and my husband was grumbling about the music. Thank you so much for asking, and sorry, I do go on.

ctx: Would you be willing to share the name of the neighbour you think is involved?
examples.msg: nah, gonna pass on that one, sorry

node.name: parts_order_confirmation
node.description: Decide how the customer responds to the summarised parts order awaiting confirmation.

ctx: To summarise: 40 titanium flange fittings, part TF-2210, $18,400, delivery in 6 weeks to your Hartwell facility. Shall I place the order?
examples.msg: Before I say yes, will these ship with material certs and a certificate of conformance?
examples.why: asks a certification question, no candidate fits

ctx: We would like to order the valve seals we discussed.
Certainly. That is 200 seals, part VS-88, delivered to Dock 3 by 14 March. Shall I confirm?
examples.msg: Nearly correct. It should be three hundred, please.
examples.why: corrects the quantity in the summary

ctx: Can you put through the bracket order from the quote?
Sure: 12 machined aluminium brackets, quote Q-5531, total $3,960, ships in 3 weeks. Confirm?
examples.msg: Actually, scrap the whole thing. Our programme just lost its funding, so we won't need them.

ctx: Here's your order: 6 pressure transducers, PT-400 series, $7,200, shipping Friday. Good to go?
examples.msg: yep, send it

ctx: Your order: 24 stainless fastener kits, part FK-12, $2,150, dispatch in 10 days. Shall I go ahead?
examples.msg: hell yeah, that's exactly the stuff, the test stand's been sitting there waiting on these forever

node.name: builders_merchant_router
node.description: Decide what the customer wants from the builders' merchant yard.

examples.msg: The lorry with my blocks was meant to be here by ten and it's nearly noon now.
examples.why: expected delivery late, wants its whereabouts

examples.msg: Could I get four cubic metres of mixed concrete brought out for a garage slab?
I'm laying a patio, about 5 by 4 metres, and I've no clue how many of those flat stone things or how much sand I need. Is that something you can work out? Also your website wouldn't load earlier.
My daughter's been on about wanting a puppy for months and I'm running out of excuses.
examples.why: personal topic unrelated to the yard

ctx: Hello! What can I help you with today?
examples.msg: Oh lovely, thank you. We finished the extension last week, finally, after my husband swore it would take a month and it took four. We've ended up with about thirty bricks and two bags of plaster we never opened. Could we bring those back to you? They're still wrapped.
Can I get the timber and sheet boards I paid for yesterday dropped at the site Monday morning? And honestly your car park is a nightmare.

node.name: survey_booking_answer
node.description: Determine what kind of information the client's reply supplies to the assistant's booking question.

conditions.a: The client gives the address or parcel number of the land to be surveyed.
conditions.b: The client states a preferred date or time window for the site visit.
conditions.c: The client indicates which kind of survey they need, such as boundary or topographic.
conditions.d: The client supplies an existing job reference or quote number for their booking.

ctx: I've called three times about my stakeout job and nobody gets back to me.
I'm sorry about that. Do you have the job reference from your confirmation email?
examples.msg: Yes, it's SV-20418. Same as the last three times I gave it.

ctx: hey so we're buying a house
Congrats! What kind of survey are you after?
examples.msg: the neighbour reckons his fence is a metre onto our side so we just wanna know where the line actually is
examples.why: describes need for a boundary survey

ctx: need to book someone out to the lot
Sure. When would suit you for the surveyor to come out?
examples.msg: any morning next week works, maybe tuesday or wednesday

ctx: Hello, I want survey for my land before I build house.
Of course. Where is the land located?
examples.msg: Is the plot 27 on Millbrook Lane, in village Ashford Green. Also I want know the price, is very expensive?

ctx: yo need a survey done at some point
No problem. What's the address of the property?
examples.msg: hold up, who won the game last night? my boy's been talking crap all morning

node.name: solar_project_router
node.description: Decide what the customer wants regarding their rooftop solar project.

conditions.a: Is the customer asking about the current stage or progress of their installation project?
conditions.b: Does the customer want to reschedule the site survey or installation appointment?
conditions.c: Is the customer reporting that their installed panels or inverter are not producing power?
conditions.d: Is the customer asking about the grid connection or export meter application?
conditions.e: Is the customer querying an invoice or a payment they have made?

examples.msg: hey so the app's been showing zero output since sunday even though it's been sunny all week
Could you tell me whether the electricity network has approved us to send surplus power back yet? We have heard nothing about the new meter.
examples.why: asks about export approval and meter

examples.msg: Where are we up to with the install? The scaffold went up two weeks ago and nothing since. Also the roofer left a ladder in our garden.
examples.why: asks how far the project has got

ctx: Hi, this is the solar project assistant. What can I do for you?
examples.msg: You've charged my card twice for the deposit. Fix it, I'm not paying three grand twice.

ctx: Hello, I have the panels from you since last year.
Great, how can I help today?
examples.msg: I want to add a battery for store the energy, can you make me offer for this?
examples.why: new battery quote, no candidate covers

examples.msg: yo the install crew's booked for friday but i'm gonna be outta town, can we bump it to the week after? also the dude on the phone was hella rude

node.name: scaffold_hire_router
node.description: Decide what the customer wants from the scaffolding hire company.

conditions.a: The customer wants a quote for hiring scaffolding on a new job.
conditions.b: The customer wants to extend the hire period of scaffolding already on site.
conditions.c: The customer wants the scaffolding taken down and collected from their site.
conditions.d: The customer reports scaffolding that looks damaged, unsafe or has been tampered with.
conditions.e: The customer wants to change the date the crew comes to erect scaffolding.
conditions.f: The customer asks for a copy of the scaffold inspection or handover certificate.
conditions.g: The customer wants extra lifts added or the existing scaffold layout altered.
conditions.h: The customer has a question or dispute about an invoice they received.
conditions.i: The customer wants to hire scaffold equipment only, without our crew erecting it.
conditions.j: The customer wants to complain about the crew's behaviour on site.

ctx: Good morning, how may I assist you with your scaffolding hire?
examples.msg: After last night's storm, several boards on the top level appear to have shifted and one of the ties is hanging loose from the wall.
examples.why: describes storm damage to the scaffold

ctx: Hi there. I can see an open invoice, INV-7731 for 2,840, and your hire on Carrow Street ending Friday. Which one is this about?
examples.msg: The first one. It's way more than we agreed, frankly ridiculous.
examples.why: picks the invoice and disputes it

examples.msg: We're re-roofing a two-storey terrace in April and need scaffolding round the front and back. What would that cost?
What's the best way to get rid of moss on a lawn?

ctx: Hello, I have booking with you for the scaffold at my house.
Thanks. I can see the crew is booked to put it up on 3 June. Would you like to keep that, or is there a problem?
examples.msg: This day is not good for me, maybe one week after?

node.name: craft_studio_router
node.description: Decide what the customer wants from the craft workshop studio.

examples.msg: I cannot come on Saturday pottery, can you move me to the next Saturday please? I don't want lose my place.
examples.why: wants to switch date, not cancel

examples.msg: Can I get myself into one of those spinning wheel clay sessions, the bowl-making one? Not sure what it's actually called.
examples.why: wants a spot in a class

examples.msg: Hello, I hope you're well. I'm booked onto the weaving afternoon on the 12th, which I was so looking forward to, but my granddaughter's school play is that very day. Could you possibly swap me onto a later weaving date? Also, the parking sign outside has fallen down. Many thanks.
examples.why: move existing booking to later date

ctx: Hey! Welcome to the studio. What can I help with?
examples.msg: yo do i gotta bring my own freaking chisels and stuff for the woodworking thing or you guys got that covered?

ctx: sup, did the pottery course last year
Nice to hear from you again! What can we do for you?
examples.msg: wanna hit the wheels solo for like a couple hours on weekends, can i just pay for the space and do my thing?

ctx: Hi, it's my mum's birthday next month.
examples.msg: She'd love the weaving stuff but I don't know which day she's free. Is there like a card or ticket I can give her so she picks herself? Is that even a thing?

node.name: image_licensing_router
node.description: Decide what the customer wants from the stock image library's support assistant.

conditions.a: The customer cannot download or access an image they already paid for, for example broken download links, expired sessions or files missing from their account.
conditions.b: The customer wants to upgrade a licence they already hold to cover wider use, such as more printed copies, merchandise or a bigger advertising campaign.
conditions.c: The customer asks which licence type fits a planned use before buying, for example web banners, book covers or social media posts.
conditions.d: The customer wants a refund or cancellation of an image or subscription purchase, for example a duplicate charge or an accidental plan renewal.

ctx: Hello! How can I help you with your image licences today?
examples.msg: Oh hello, thank you. I've been taking photographs as a hobby for nearly twenty years, mostly coastal scenes, and my nephew, who is a designer, says I really ought to share them. Could I submit some of my own photos to be sold in your library?
examples.why: wants to become a contributor, not covered

examples.msg: we haven't bought it yet but we want one of your photos on a cookbook cover, which licence would cover that?
examples.why: pre-purchase licence choice for a cover

examples.msg: Hey, my yearly plan just renewed and I totally forgot to cancel it. Can I get that money back?

ctx: We bought a standard licence for the mountain lake photo last month.
Thanks, I can see that order. What would you like to do with it?
examples.msg: The client now wants it on t-shirts and tote bags as well, so we need what we have to stretch to that.

ctx: Hi, how can I help today?
examples.msg: I paid for the city skyline image an hour ago and the button in my account just spins and then shows an error.
